player_001_elara.message: Greetings, traveler! Welcome to Elara's Apothecary. How may I assist you on this fine day? We have healing potions, mana potions, and stamina elixirs available if you need some help with your journey. Remember, safety in use is crucial for optimal results.

test_player_1_elara.message: Who id the mayor of buglia?
The mayor of Buglia is a fair and festival-loving woman named Lira. She keeps our town running smoothly.
